facts.raw_span: A 48-year-old woman
no breast symptoms
routine screening mammography
a new 1.4-cm developing asymmetry in the inner quadrant of the right breast
no discrete abnormality corresponding to the mammographic finding
tomosynthesis-guided vacuum-assisted biopsy of the right inner breast
yielding 12 core specimens
marked perilobular and periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils, with lymphocytes and plasma cells and no granulomata
no history of urticaria, asthma, angioedema, or pruritus except for seasonal allergic rhinitis
Peripheral blood eosinophil levels were within the normal range
Hypereosinophilic syndrome was excluded from consideration

support_spans: marked perilobular and periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils, with lymphocytes and plasma cells and no granulomata
contradict_spans: Peripheral blood eosinophil levels were within the normal range
